extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, applicants, agents, and members of the public
extracted.subtask_description: Announcement of revisions to the Canadian Intellectual Property Office's Manual of Patent Office Practice (MOPOP), summarizing clarified guidance in specific chapters for patent examination and operational procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correspondence procedures and operational formalities procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapters 1–3 have been updated to reflect the most recent practice notice respecting correspondence procedures and to provide clarification on operational formalities procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the updated correspondence procedures and operational formalities as reflected in MOPOP chapters 1–3; consult the MOPOP Revision History web page for a comprehensive list of changes and the most recent practice notice for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Examination Interview Service (PEIS) information
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapters 1 and 13 have been updated to include information relating to the Patent Examination Interview Service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the revised material in chapters 1 and 13 for guidance on the use and procedures of the Patent Examination Interview Service when arranging or conducting interviews between applicants/agents and examiners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation of sequence listings (including removal of non‑essential sequences)
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 17 provides clarified practice guidance with regard to the presentation of sequence listings, which is particularly pertinent with regard to amendments that intend to remove non-essential sequence(s) from a listing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing or amending sequence listings, adhere to the clarified presentation requirements in MOPOP chapter 17; the chapter addresses how sequence listings should be presented and how to handle amendments to remove non-essential sequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of multiple co-pending reissue applications for the same patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 23 has been updated with practice guidance for the examination of multiple co-pending applications for reissue for the same patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the updated procedures in MOPOP chapter 23 when multiple co-pending reissue applications exist for the same patent; the chapter supplies the Patent Office's practice for examining and handling such situations.

rubrics_metrics.name: MOPOP as the Patent Office's interpretive guide
rubrics_metrics.description: The MOPOP is a guide for patent examiners, applicants, agents and members of the public who are looking for information about the operational procedures and examination practices of CIPO. Practices expressed in the MOPOP reflect the Patent Office's interpretation of the Patent Act, the Patent Rules and jurisprudence, as of the date each chapter or section came into effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat MOPOP chapters as the Patent Office's official practice and interpretive guidance for examination and operational procedures; confirm the effective date of each chapter/section and consult MOPOP Revision History for changes. For questions about revisions, contact the Acting Program Manager, Examination Practice (Jeremy McLean).
